'''Sintheti''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Sintheti system/Legends|Sintheti system]], a part of the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its surface featured crags.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

In [[402 BBY/Legends|402 BBY]], rival claimants to Sintheti's [[Horned Throne]] hired the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and [[Sun Guard]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups, respectively.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> In the resulting [[Battle of Sintheti]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> the two groups, which were fierce rivals themselves, fought each other for more than three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] amid the celestial body's crags and within its catacombs.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sintheti was introduced via mention of the Battle of Sintheti in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GaW" /> It was originally meant to be identified as a distinct celestial body in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned Sintheti was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Sintheti was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sintheti [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Sintheti itself, in grid square N-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
